       COLUMN_NAME, SYSTEM_COLUMN_NAME, ORDINAL_POSITION, DATA_TYPE, LENGTH,
       NUMERIC_SCALE, CCSID, IS_NULLABLE, IS_IDENTITY, HIDDEN, HAS_FLDPROC,
       BUFFER_POSITION, BUFFER_LENGTH, STORAGE, CHARACTER_OCTET_LENGTH,

queries.name: keys

SELECT K.COLUMN_NAME, K.ORDINAL_POSITION, K.CONSTRAINT_SCHEMA, K.CONSTRAINT_NAME
FROM QSYS2.SYSKEYCST K JOIN QSYS2.SYSCST C
  ON K.CONSTRAINT_SCHEMA = C.CONSTRAINT_SCHEMA AND K.CONSTRAINT_NAME = C.CONSTRAINT_NAME
WHERE C.TABLE_SCHEMA = ? AND C.TABLE_NAME = ? AND C.CONSTRAINT_TYPE = 'PRIMARY KEY'
ORDER BY K.ORDINAL_POSITION

SELECT SYSTEM_TABLE_SCHEMA, SYSTEM_TABLE_NAME, NATIVE_TYPE, FILE_TYPE,
       NUMBER_MEMBERS, NUMBER_RECORD_FORMATS, FORMAT_LEVEL_ID, FORMAT_NAME, RECORD_LENGTH, NUMBER_FIELDS,
       CONTAINS_LOB, CONTAINS_VARYING_LENGTH
FROM QSYS2.SYSFILES WHERE SYSTEM_TABLE_SCHEMA = ? AND SYSTEM_TABLE_NAME = ?

queries.name: object
queries.sql:
SELECT CASE WHEN LENGTH(PATH_NAME) <= 55 THEN CAST(PATH_NAME AS VARCHAR(55) CCSID 1208) ELSE NULL END AS PATH_NAME,
       LENGTH(PATH_NAME) AS PATH_LENGTH, OBJECT_TYPE, ASP_NUMBER, STORED_LOCAL,
       CASE WHEN SYMBOLIC_LINK IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS HAS_SYMBOLIC_LINK,
       FILE_SYSTEM_IDENTIFIER, FILE_IDENTIFIER_NUMBER, GENERATION_IDENTIFIER,
       JOURNALED, JOURNAL_LIBRARY, JOURNAL_NAME, HEX(JOURNAL_IDENTIFIER) AS OBJECT_JID
FROM TABLE(QSYS2.IFS_OBJECT_STATISTICS(
    START_PATH_NAME => ?, SUBTREE_DIRECTORIES => 'NO', OBJECT_TYPE_LIST => ?, IGNORE_ERRORS => 'NO')) AS O

queries.name: journal
queries.sql:
SELECT JOURNAL_LIBRARY, JOURNAL_NAME, JOURNAL_TYPE, JOURNAL_STATE, ASP_NUMBER, JOURNAL_ASPGRP,
       ATTACHED_JOURNAL_RECEIVER_LIBRARY, ATTACHED_JOURNAL_RECEIVER_NAME,
       REMOVE_INTERNAL_ENTRIES, REMOVE_FIXED_LENGTH_DETAIL, MINIMIZE_ESD_FOR_FILES, JOURNAL_CACHE
FROM QSYS2.JOURNAL_INFO WHERE JOURNAL_LIBRARY = ? AND JOURNAL_NAME = ?

queries.name: receivers
queries.sql:
SELECT JOURNAL_LIBRARY, JOURNAL_NAME, JOURNAL_RECEIVER_LIBRARY, JOURNAL_RECEIVER_NAME,
       JOURNAL_RECEIVER_ASP_NUMBER, STATUS, FIRST_SEQUENCE_NUMBER, LAST_SEQUENCE_NUMBER,
       PREVIOUS_JOURNAL_RECEIVER_LIBRARY, PREVIOUS_JOURNAL_RECEIVER,
       NEXT_JOURNAL_RECEIVER_LIBRARY, NEXT_JOURNAL_RECEIVER,
       MINIMIZE_ESD_FOR_FILES, FIXED_LENGTH_DATA_INCLUDES_JOB_NAME, FIXED_LENGTH_DATA_INCLUDES_THREAD_ID,
       FIXED_LENGTH_DATA_INCLUDES_LOGICAL_UNIT_OF_WORK_ID, FIXED_LENGTH_DATA_INCLUDES_TRANSACTION_ID
FROM QSYS2.JOURNAL_RECEIVER_INFO WHERE JOURNAL_LIBRARY = ? AND JOURNAL_NAME = ?
